name: Sound Bite
job: Put one real quote at a time in the hero, typed out fast, with who said it, so social proof reads in a glance without a wall of testimonials.

anatomy.role: 2px cyan rule on the left, the quote's only frame
Display face at headline size; the untyped rest is laid out but transparent, so typing never moves the page
A cyan block after the typed text while typing; no blink
Mono, sentence case (caps on a long label fail the all-caps rule): name in `text`, role and company in `text-secondary`
Prev, the count, Next and Pause, each 44px; shown only once the script runs

states.name: Rotating, typed
states.note: Types each quote at about 16ms per two characters, holds 6.5s, then the next. Hover or focus holds it; Pause stops it (WCAG 2.2.2).

states.name: Reduced motion
states.note: No typing and no auto-advance; Prev and Next still work and Pause is hidden.

use_when: The hero needs social proof and the quotes are real, attributed and already public (a recommendation, a client line).
Two to five short quotes, each under about 30 words.
avoid_when: Never invent or paraphrase a quote, and never use one without the person's name and role.
Do not use it for a single long testimonial; use 31 Callout or plain text.
Do not stack several of them on one page.

data.note: `text` verbatim from its public source; `name` and `role` exactly as published.
Where the quotes are published, shown at the right of the controls.

access: Without the script every quote shows as a list; the script hides all but one with `visibility` and `aria-hidden`, so the box keeps the tallest quote's height and nothing below jumps.
The full text is in the DOM while typing (the rest is transparent, not missing), so a screen reader reads the whole quote; the count is a polite live region.
`prefers-reduced-motion` turns off typing and the timer; Pause, hover and focus all hold it.
gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`motion_policy_gate.py`: no repeating animation; the caret does not blink.
`page_gate.py` and `artifact_wrap_lint.py` on every page that carries it.
